# Model validation against published plans

Generated by `scripts/plans/report.py`. Walls are traced from the raster plan of each PDF. The scale is calibrated so interior rooms add up to the printed interior areas; then room boundaries that have no wall on the plan (open plans, corridors split at a doorway, terraces) are moved until each room matches its printed m². **Raw Δ** is the trace before that fit; **Model Δ** is what the 3D model shows (rooms enclosed by walls cannot be moved, so their Δ stays). Rooms marked * had no wall between them on the plan. Names marked ° were not printed on the plan (only the area) and are inferred from the drawing.

Measured, not published: storey heights (ground 3,80 m, typical 3,30 m, clear 2,60 m) from the published orthographic elevation of Mykonos. Inferred: door swing, furniture and sanitary positions (beds follow the bed symbols of each plan), façade material per panel, orientation (no north arrow on the plans). Mykonos Portal 2 repeats Portal 1 (client instruction).
